en: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Jubayr al-Kinani
tr: Muhammed b. Ahmed İbn Cübeyr el-Kinânî
ar: محمد بن أحمد ابن جبير الكناني

description.tr: Rihlesi, Haçlı dönemi Akdeniz'inin en iyi birinci şahıs anlatımıdır || Masa başı coğrafyacılarından farklı olarak İbn Cübeyr doğrudan deneyimden yazdı. || [Tarih notu] 1185 Suriye depreminin anlatımı ve Norman Sicilya'sının Arap-Hristiyan kültürü betimlemesi benzersiz biçimde değerlidir.
description.en: His Rihla is the finest first-person account of the Crusader-era Mediterranean — revealing daily life, trade, and interfaith interactions in 12th-century Egypt, Syria, and Sicily || Unlike armchair geographers, Ibn Jubayr wrote from direct experience. His observations of Crusader-Muslim coexistence in the Levant challenge simplistic narratives of perpetual conflict. || [Historiographical note] His account of the 1185 earthquake in Syria and his description of Norman Sicily's Arab-Christian culture are uniquely valuable.
description.ar: رحلته أدق شهادة شخصية عن البحر المتوسط في عصر الصليبيين || على عكس الجغرافيين النظريين، كتب ابن جبير من تجربة مباشرة
